title: Cloudways Review 2026: Pricing, Servers and Who It Suits
excerpt: Cloudways starts at $11 a month on DigitalOcean with no contract and a 5-day free trial. Here is what you really pay, how fast it tested, what the Black Friday offer is worth and who should choose it.

meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Cloudways Review 2026: Pricing, Servers and Who It Suits
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Cloudways review for 2026: how the cloud server plans work, what you pay, the free trial, WordPress hosting and who should choose it, with setup steps.
meta.rl_answer: Cloudways is managed cloud hosting with pay as you go prices from $11 a month and no renewal jump. Backups, email and a CDN cost extra. A 5-day free trial needs no card.
meta.rl_faqs:
What is Cloudways hosting? | Cloudways is managed cloud hosting. It sets up servers on providers such as DigitalOcean, Vultr, Linode, AWS and Google Cloud, tunes them for WordPress and looks after them. You manage the site, and Cloudways manages the server.
Is Cloudways shared hosting? | No. Cloudways gives your site its own cloud server resources and bills by server size. Shared hosting puts many sites on one server for a fixed price.
How much does Cloudways cost? | Flexible starts at $11 a month for a 1 GB DigitalOcean server, with $14, $28, $54 and $99 Premium sizes above it. Autonomous is $99, $199 or $399 a month. Billing is by the hour, with no contract.
Does Cloudways have a free trial? | Yes. Cloudways lists a 5-day free trial on Flexible and a 3-day trial on Autonomous, with no credit card. TechRadar describes a 3-day trial, so check the length when you sign up.
Does Cloudways have a money-back guarantee? | TechRadar says there is no conventional money-back guarantee, and the free trial is the safest way to inspect the platform. Check Cloudways' terms before you pay.
What is the Cloudways Black Friday offer? | Create a new account with code BFCM802 by 4 December 2026 for 80% off the first 2 months, up to $200 off a month. Over a first year that saves about 13%.
Is Cloudways good for WordPress? | Yes for growing sites, stores and agencies. It has staging, cloning, backups, Object Cache Pro on 4 GB servers and above, and a server firewall. There is no cPanel and no bundled domain or email.
What server does Cloudways recommend? | TechRadar says Cloudways suggests 2 GB or more for a production or low-traffic site. The 1 GB server is a starting point, best tested on the free trial.
What are the hidden costs of Cloudways? | Off-site backups cost $0.033 per GB a month, business email $1.50 per mailbox, Cloudflare Enterprise CDN from $4.99 per domain and malware protection from $4 per app. Advanced support is $100 a month.
Does Cloudways increase prices at renewal? | No. Cloudways bills as you go with no contract, so there is no first-term discount that expires. The price you see is the price you keep paying, apart from add-ons.
Is Cloudways fast? | Yes in independent tests. TechRadar measured a 903 ms Largest Contentful Paint and an A grade on GTmetrix. Experte measured a 0.266 s first response and 100% uptime. These used lightweight test sites.
Does Cloudways include a domain or email? | No. Cloudways does not sell domains. Email is a paid add-on through Rackspace at $1.50 per mailbox a month.
Is Cloudways better than Kinsta for a small WooCommerce store? | It depends on size and extras. Expertah priced a store on a Medium server with a CDN and malware protection at about $63 a month. Kinsta's entry plan was $35 a month after its first-month offer. Compare them at your own traffic.

meta.rl_takeaways:
Cloudways Flexible starts at $11 a month on DigitalOcean, pay as you go, with no contract (Cloudways, 20 Nov 2026).
The free trial is 5 days on Flexible and 3 days on Autonomous, with no card.
Code BFCM802 gives 80% off the first 2 months by 4 Dec 2026, about 13% off a first year.
Backups, email, a CDN and malware protection cost extra.
meta.rl_r_verdict: Cloudways is a strong choice for a growing WordPress site that needs cloud speed and control without running a server. Budget for the extras, use the free trial before you pay, and skip it if you want the simplest all-in-one host.
meta.rl_r_buy:
Your WordPress site or store has outgrown shared hosting.
You want pay as you go prices with no renewal jump.
You are comfortable with a dashboard and a few technical terms.
meta.rl_r_skip:
You want one bill for hosting, a domain and email.
You are an absolute beginner who wants cPanel.
You want the lowest price for a tiny site.
meta.rl_r_pros:
Pay as you go with no contract or renewal jump.
Five cloud providers and many locations.
Staging, cloning and backups in a clear dashboard.
Fast results in independent tests and quick support.
A free trial with no card.
meta.rl_r_cons:
No bundled domain, email or cPanel.
Backups, email, CDN and malware protection cost extra.
No conventional money-back guarantee.
More technical than a beginner host.
Stopping a server does not stop charges.

meta.rl_r_method:
Our own use | We do not host our own site on Cloudways, so this is a research-based review. We did not run our own tests
Pricing and offers | Cloudways' pricing page and home page, read on 20 November 2026, with plan prices checked against Expertah (November 2026)
Independent tests | TechRadar (October 2026), Few Servers (October 2026), Experte and HostingStep (October 2025 to May 2026)
Competitor reviews | The top-ranking Cloudways reviews read for structure and questions: TechRadar, Expertah, Experte, Few Servers and WPSchool
Questions people ask | The questions the top pages answer in their headings, plus the questions people search for in Semrush, such as what Cloudways costs, whether it is shared hosting and how it compares with Kinsta
When sources disagree | We show both views and say which we used. For the trial length we used Cloudways' own page (5 days for Flexible) and noted TechRadar's 3 days
Our calculations | The Black Friday table is our own arithmetic from Cloudways' list prices and offer
Freshness | Prices and offers are read again before this page goes live, and the page carries the date they were checked
What we did not do | We did not run our own speed or uptime test. Each test number is credited to the team that measured it

meta.rl_r_final: Cloudways gives a growing WordPress site cloud speed and control without a server to run. Use the free trial, budget for the extras, and pick a size of 2 GB or more for a real site.
